context_requirements: Neuronal or neuroendocrine lineage with substantial BACE1 expression and APP processing
Expression of APP and the gamma-secretase complex for BACE1 inhibition to alter Abeta production
Presence of familial Alzheimer's disease mutations in PSEN1 or APP to reveal a phenotype
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of amyloid-beta or APP-related transcriptional signatures after treatment
Consistent changes in apoptosis, p53 target, or caspase-related landmark genes across multiple lines

evidence.supports: A beta-secretase inhibitor attenuated caspase-3/7 activation and recovered viability in cells expressing mutant presenilin 1, indicating BACE1 inhibition can modulate apoptosis only in a mutant-PS1 context.
A beta-secretase inhibitor decreased intracellular Abeta and restrained p53 protein upregulation in mutant PS1-transfected cells, showing a measurable effect only in a disease-mutant background.
